events.title: 동커스터 로버스 win the competition for lower-division football league clubs, as they beat 브리스틀 로버스 3–2 after extra time in the Johnstone's Paint Trophy at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff .
대거넘 앤드 레드브리지 win the Conference National and promotion to the Football League .
St Albans City are relegated from the Conference National . 브렌트퍼드 are relegated to League Two.

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat Roma 7–1 in the Champions League quarter-final second leg at Old Trafford , completing an 8–3 aggregate victory and booking their first semi-final appearance in the competition for five years.

Football : The semi-finals of Copa del Rey begin in Nou Camp . Argentinian 리오넬 메시 scored a spectacular goal against 헤타페 . That goal is very similar to a 디에고 마라도나 's goal against England in Mexico World Cup 1986. Both of them passed six defenders including goalkeeper and scored.
토키 유나이티드 are relegated to the Conference. 스컨소프 유나이티드 are promoted to the Championship. 하틀리풀 유나이티드 and 월솔 are both promoted to League One. 로더럼 유나이티드 are relegated to League Two.
UEFA chooses Poland and Ukraine as joint hosts for the 2012 UEFA European Football Championship . (BBC)
루턴 타운 are relegated to League One.
왓퍼드 are relegated from the Premiership. Droylsden are promoted to the Conference.

크리스티아누 호날두 is named PFA Player of the Year as well as PFA Young Player of the Year . Eight out of the eleven players who are named in the PFA Premiership Team of the Year are 맨체스터 유나이티드 players, including Ronaldo.
Tamworth and 사우스포트 are relegated from the Conference. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat AC 밀란 3–2 in the Champions League semi-final first leg at Old Trafford.
사우스엔드 유나이티드 are relegated from the Championship. 체스터필드 and 브래드퍼드 시티 are both relegated from League One.
더비 카운티 lose to 크리스털 팰리스 meaning that 버밍엄 시티 and 선덜랜드 are promoted to the Premiership. 샘 앨러다이스 resigns after seven and a half years as manager of 볼턴 원더러스 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain five points ahead of 첼시 with both left with three games to play, but both have secured automatic Champions League qualification, meaning 리버풀 and 아스널 will both have to face a two-legged tie to secure qualification to the group stage. Two points separate Bolton, 에버턴, Reading, 포츠머스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the race to qualify for the UEFA Cup . At the bottom of the table 왓퍼드 have already been relegated, with Charlton and a resurgent 웨스트햄 유나이티드 completing the relegation zone but still with a slim chance of survival at the possible expense of 위건 애슬레틱, 풀럼, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 미들즈브러.
Sammy Lee is promoted from the coaching staff to the manager's seat at 볼턴 원더러스.
